Temporary statlist is a bounded three-node fixture; free/toggle callbacks and extended lists are stubs.
Percentage helper uses source integer semantics; ordinary critical is a supplied1x/2x precursor. Only magic conversion is exercised.
limits: Legacy isolated blocks do not prove current D2R executable parity.
